purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for prioritizing the single Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are ordinal discovery priorities, not measured search volumes or eligibility evidence. Community/Q&A sources may support recurrence discovery only; truth-bearing facts require the listed primary sources.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. These scores guide eval/retrieval work only and never promote a support claim to VERIFIED.

natural_language_queries: den andra föräldern betalar inte vad kan jag få
vad är skillnaden på underhåll och underhållsstöd
förälder betalar bara ibland vem ska jag ringa
barnet bor varannan vecka ska någon betala underhåll
den andra föräldern bor utomlands vem hjälper med underhåll

demand_signal.basis: Försäkringskassan maintains a dedicated national section with separate current guidance for direct maintenance, missing/partial payment and cross-border cases, plus dedicated maintenance-support statistics. This is a qualitative reach signal, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: Everyday language collapses underhållsbidrag and underhållsstöd into one word, while equal residence, partial payment and cross-border context can change the relevant route.

miss_consequence.basis: Wrong routing can delay a child-related payment/application, create incorrect amount expectations or produce avoidable conflict between parents.

source_fragmentation.basis: Core truth is concentrated at Försäkringskassan, but separate pages and processes cover direct parent payments, state support and international cases; disagreement can also lead to municipal collaboration talks or legal help.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as underhållsbidrag, underhållsstöd, växelvist boende and partial payment are less intuitive than the natural-language problem and are difficult to turn into a safe next action across languages.

steps_to_action.basis: A safe public route needs only the residence pattern and current payment status before choosing the relevant primary source; material eligibility, amount and legal-obligation facts should not all be collected before showing the source.

recurrence_signal.basis: Public Q&A and community discussions repeatedly vary the same questions around who pays, what happens after separation, equal residence and whether state support fills a payment gap. Those sources are discovery only, never truth.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: A v11 canonical regression already protected the terminology split, but the public product had not converted that learning into a focused natural-language handoff and had no permanent equal-residence or cross-border regression. v51 closes those specific gaps without creating a new engine.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Convert the existing v11 maintenance learning into a guarded focus=child_maintenance route in the same root/person product, ask only residence and payment facts that change the route, and add equal-residence/cross-border regressions while keeping material eligibility and amounts review-gated.
signals.truth_rule: Discovery signal is not truth; VERIFY current conditions, amounts, individual payment obligations and application route against Försäkringskassan. Do not infer entitlement from separation/nonpayment, or infer that equal residence means maintenance can never be relevant.

demand_signal.basis: Part-time sickness benefit is a common transition where practical scheduling questions arise after the benefit decision.

friction_signal.basis: Users can confuse an employer scheduling agreement with the separate requirement to coordinate benefit-relevant work distribution.

miss_consequence.basis: Incorrect advice can affect sickness-benefit administration and create payment or reporting problems.

source_fragmentation.basis: The user must coordinate employer realities with Försäkringskassan benefit rules.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as degree of sickness benefit and distribution of working time are less intuitive than the user's scheduling question.

steps_to_action.basis: A safe next step requires current degree, proposed distribution and whether work extent is changing.

recurrence_signal.basis: Försäkringskassan maintains a dedicated FAQ answer for this exact practical issue.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: Employee support existed, but no permanent scenario forced both-employer-and-Försäkringskassan coordination for part-time scheduling.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Add employee regression that blocks employer-only approval claims and prioritizes the minimum facts needed to determine whether schedule or work extent changes must be coordinated.
signals.truth_rule: Verify current sickness-benefit guidance and the person's current decision before making benefit or schedule claims.

natural_language_queries: vem söker jag personlig assistans hos kommunen eller försäkringskassan
jag behöver mycket hjälp hemma vem ska jag ringa

demand_signal.basis: Personal assistance has dedicated national and municipal application routes and affects both adults and children.

friction_signal.basis: The same everyday need can route to municipality or Försäkringskassan depending on assessed fundamental-needs hours and other conditions.

miss_consequence.basis: Wrong authority routing can delay access to a high-impact disability support process.

source_fragmentation.basis: National Försäkringskassan rules and municipal application responsibilities coexist.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: LSS person-group and fundamental-needs concepts are difficult to infer from a natural description of daily assistance needs.

steps_to_action.basis: A safe route requires functional-need facts and authority boundary verification rather than diagnosis-only routing.

recurrence_signal.basis: Both national and municipal guidance repeatedly explain the authority split.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: Disability scenarios exist, but the authority split remains a high-consequence retrieval/routing area for continued testing.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Queue a future synthetic authority-routing scenario that asks about functional assistance needs and verifies municipality versus Försäkringskassan without diagnosis-based entitlement inference.
signals.truth_rule: Do not convert diagnosis, estimated hours or user wording into entitlement; verify current official criteria and responsible authority.

demand_signal.basis: The company pilot and official procurement guidance both center on finding real opportunities and understanding requirements.

friction_signal.basis: Users can be forced through generic readiness questions before reaching the actual official search/action path.

miss_consequence.basis: Excess steps mainly cause abandonment or wasted effort rather than direct legal/benefit harm.

source_fragmentation.basis: Announcements are spread across registered databases and specific procurement documents control the actual requirements.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terminology is specialized but the current pilot already explains several procurement concepts in plain Swedish.

steps_to_action.basis: The current company UI can ask up to seven questions before showing next actions, including a free-text description that does not affect routing.

recurrence_signal.basis: Finding the right procurement and understanding what is mandatory are recurring official guidance topics.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: Truth/source coverage is relatively strong, but the interactive information-gain path remains inefficient.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Self-revise the company interaction so questions are asked only when they change the route or readiness advice; keep procurement-specific source verification intact.
signals.truth_rule: Do not treat UX prioritization as procurement truth; verify specific procurement documents and official sources before any procurement claim.
